note: Campground and RV park with a bar and grill on the Upper Iowa River at Bluffton, northwest of Decorah, open since 1979 (formerly Randy's Bluffton Store and Campground); canoe and kayak rentals with shuttle. In 2026 the same owners bought White's Riverside across the river (id 3233), being renamed Kenny's Corner. --Claude
summary: Passes the private gate: cheapest RV night $40 + $5 stay fee + Campspot 3% (about $46, Campspot 2026-10-13), Google 4.4/258, own site + phone + live Campspot, no long-stay red flags. Season, booking, pull-throughs and dump confirmed from the operator. Not a duplicate of 3233 (other bank, own address and Google listing). Waterfront re-audit lead.
flags: PRIVATE GATE PASS: (price) cheapest RV night is the $40 30-amp back-in, pull-through or 'Waterfront Campsite' type plus the park's $5 per-stay fee plus Campspot's 3% (min $3) = about $46-48 for one night, from the stored Campspot quote of 2026-10-13 (season now closed; 2027 not yet bookable, so not re-quoted); no gateway within 40 km (nearest Wisconsin Dells 175 km). (reviews) Google 4.4 from 258 reviews. (presence) blufftonresort.com, phone (563) 735-5738, live Campspot listing. (long-stay tests) 1 nightly rate under $50: yes; 2 nights sold one at a time on Campspot, no application: yes; 3 no standing minimum seen (one-night quotes): yes; 4 transient share: most of the park is Campspot nightly types: yes; 5 no residents or lots for sale: yes. The RV page offers 'Long-Term RV Camping' and 'a seasonal stay' as options, which doesn't change any test.

DUPLICATE CHECK vs 3233 White's Riverside: NOT a duplicate. Bluffton is 2619 W Ravine Rd on the east/south bank (its campground is the open field and lanes around the bar, pin 43.4026,-91.9137 on the bar); White's is 2633 W Ravine Rd on the opposite bank, reached over the W Ravine Rd bridge, about 280 m NW (43.4042,-91.9162). Each has its own Google listing (White's 4.6/105 with phone 563-735-5633; Bluffton 4.4/258 with 563-735-5738). Same owner since 2026: Bluffton's banner says 'call (563) 735-5738 to book a spot in the new "Kenny's Corner" at Bluffton Resort'. If AWH wants one entry per operator, merging is a judgment call; by the split rule (separate places with their own entrances) they read as two campgrounds. 3233 carries Bluffton's phone, 563-735-5738, which now matches the banner, though Google still lists 563-735-5633 for White's.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored not waterfront): Campspot sells a 'Waterfront Campsite' type ($40, per the 2026-10-13 quote) and the operator advertises 'Riverside RV Sites'. On Esri a lane runs along the river at the park's west edge (about 43.4022,-91.9158), with sites between the lane and a sandy bank about 20-40 m from the water, the Upper Iowa about 25-30 m wide there, so creekside/riverfront is the borderline. The stored evidence measured from the bar area (150-200 m). I couldn't see whether those riverside sites take RVs; Campspot's per-site map (campspot_map.py, needs the driver) would settle it. No change proposed without it.
